options.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one square visual option card illustration for a fantasy RPG character creation menu, showing the horn style ONLY by example on a generic nonhuman mannequin head. A neutral featureless smooth charcoal-gray head and short neck, bald, no eyes, no face, no ears, frontal symmetrical view. The head is a simple low-detail sculptural guide, not a real person. The horns are the subject: richly detailed reddish-brown keratin with subtle natural ridges, exactly TWO horns with anatomically mirrored roots at the same height on the left and right upper sides of the skull, equivalent distance from the forehead. Two matching ram-like horns curling OUTWARD and DOWN in a single compact C-shaped curve beside the head, unbranched, exactly one pointed tip per horn. Both roots are attached to the skull, never forehead center versus crown, never floating. Detailed painterly semi-realistic medieval fantasy inventory illustration, soft even lighting, horns prominent and easy to distinguish at thumbnail size. Entire horn tips fully inside frame with generous margins. Plain dark charcoal background #171512. No text, labels, frame, symbols, weapons, clothes, hair, extra heads, extra horns, forks or split tips.
